purpose: Choose the next V4 performance target after the V2.14 per-app primitive audit, without repeating the error of treating V2.14 primitives or partner/front-door migration as new V4 speed wins.

inputs.v2_14_source_probe: git show v2.14:src/rtdsl/aggregate_tree_reference.py and git show v2.14:src/rtdsl/optix_runtime.py

why_this_target: The V2.14 audit shows existing benchmark apps already had primitive routes, so the next target must be a new runtime lever or a material same-primitive improvement.
git show v2.14 confirms V2.14 had generic aggregate-frontier host/native collection but did not expose AGGREGATE_FRONTIER_DEVICE_COLUMNS_2D or its prepare/run/destroy device-column symbols.

Current source exposes AGGREGATE_FRONTIER_DEVICE_COLUMNS_2D with app-generic contract, device-resident payload handoff, same-stream/event-order requirement, and forbidden host frontier rows before partner continuation.
This target attacks the exact V3/V4 bottleneck class: host materialization of hierarchical frontier rows between RTDL traversal and partner continuation.

Barnes-Hut can be used only as a benchmark probe because it stresses hierarchical frontier plus weighted continuation; the V4 engine target remains aggregate-frontier device columns, not a Barnes-Hut kernel.
why_not_existing_fused_weighted_vector_s: The existing aggregate-tree fused weighted-vector implementation remains rejected as a V4.0 public target as-is.
It contains domain-shaped force-law semantics and records CUDA-driver execution inside the OptiX backend rather than RT-core traversal evidence.
Goal4673 does not authorize relabeling that implementation as generic Tier-2 performance.

v2_14_denominator.v2_14_logical_family: generic aggregate-frontier collect plus app/partner continuation
v2_14_denominator.v2_14_route_for_app_probe: RTDL/OptiX aggregate-frontier membership plus explicit CuPy/Numba force-vector continuation
v2_14_denominator.denominator_rule: V4 must compare against the strongest V2.14 logical aggregate-frontier route, not against a weak CPU or toy route. If the V2.14 archive contains an equivalent device-column path under another name, this target must be reclassified as same-primitive improvement before any run.

required_before_pod: static source audit proving the selected surface is app-name-free
static source audit proving the selected surface does not wrap the old host-row collector
static source audit proving the selected surface forbids host frontier row materialization before partner continuation
static source audit preserving the RT-core claim boundary: CUDA-driver device-column execution is not RT-core traversal evidence unless OptiX trace is proven in the measured path
frozen correctness parity oracle for aggregate-frontier rows and downstream weighted-vector summaries
frozen V2.14, V3.0.2, and current V4 denominators
frozen numeric material-speed bars before any hardware run
review request or recorded review debt for the target choice
kill_conditions: V2.14 is found to have an equivalent device-column aggregate-frontier primitive
the current implementation cannot run without host frontier row materialization before partner continuation
the only app-level win requires Barnes-Hut or force-law identity in the engine
phase telemetry shows the device-column lever is too small to plausibly move app-level hot path by 20 percent
correctness parity fails against the frozen reference

rejected_or_deferred_targets.reason: git show v2.14 confirms segment-pair, directed point-location, and RayJoin CDB point-location symbols already existed, including prepared-left/direct/grouped-range variants. A V4 front door would be useful but cannot be counted as a clean new speed lever without a material same-primitive improvement over V2.14.
V2.14 already had collect-k bounded native symbols and contact-manifold bounded witness routes. This remains a possible same-primitive improvement target, not the first new V4 lever.
V2.14 already had prepared any-hit collision flag primitives.
Focused RTDBSCAN evidence did not clear the second-win bar, and V2.14 already had the core count-threshold/grouped-union route.
Existing fused weighted-vector route has force-law/app-domain risk and no RT-core claim basis; it may inform tests but cannot be promoted as-is.

review_state.implementation_can_continue_before_exter: only local static/protocol work; no POD performance claim and no release wording

goal_level_decision_audit.stupid_action: The risk was to jump from the V2.14 primitive audit into another convenient existing benchmark app target without proving that the target contains a V2.14-absent runtime lever.
goal_level_decision_audit.alternative_path: Select a V2.14-absent generic runtime lever first, freeze denominators and bars, and keep app names as probes only.
goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Use AGGREGATE_FRONTIER_DEVICE_COLUMNS_2D as the conditional Goal4674 target, with no POD run until the pre-POD gate is satisfied.

next_action: Goal4674 should perform the local static/protocol feasibility gate for v4_aggregate_frontier_device_columns_2d_prepared_runner. Only if that gate passes should a focused POD benchmark be requested.
